summary: Publish the Fractal UI Storybook to one canonical Cloudflare site from main

schema.detail: No application schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No runtime admission or reconciliation rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds a separate, non-required Storybook deployment workflow and an Alchemy v2 stack with Cloudflare remote state. Every push to main deploys stage main to https://storybook.compounding.tech by default. There are no PR previews or close-cleanup jobs; deployment credentials are exposed only to code on main and no draft-policy exception is needed. Existing required checks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Static Storybook hosting is independent of the application and daemon.

manual.detail: An administrator must configure CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID for an existing Cloudflare account, authorize remote-state bootstrap and deployment, and configure the custom-domain zone or choose workers.dev. See docs/development.md#storybook-deployment.

recovery.detail: Redeploy the desired revision to stage main with the same Cloudflare account and remote state to restore Storybook content.
